name: dokumentART European Film Festival 2026
description: With a 30-year history of presenting European short films (up to 30 minutes), the festival places special emphasis on socially engaged cinema and formally daring works, including hybrid, experimental, and boundary-blurring forms. Curated by a team of experienced programmers connected with Berlinale, Kassel, achtung berlin and Slamdance festival seeks voices that push cinematic language into new territories while engaging with contemporary social, political, and aesthetic concerns.
